26420, 26421, 26422, 26423, 26424, 26425, 26426, 26427: The draft states D waits for P, B for D and L for B without explaining that each relevant vehicle comes from the other driver’s right. This leaves the tested priority rule, especially for 26421–26423, unexplained; tie those waits to the figure and article 145(2).

26428, 26429, 26430, 26431, 26432, 26433: The draft states C waits for E but does not explain the decisive opposing-traffic conflict: C turns left across E’s path, while E turns right. Explain why C yields to E as well as why M yields to C; cite authority supporting the turning manoeuvre.
